title: Nice quality
text: Nice quality. Nice quality but f you don’t want to use the top shelf it’s not a great design.  I added dowels to the sides to hold cookie sheets up and it looks a little odd but it works.  Had to take the basket off the track to install and it was tough to reach in the narrow space to do it.  Since I don’t use the top shelf I use the front dowel to slide out and it’s a little wobbly but I don’t want to have to finagle cookie sheets out from under the top shelf.  This was the only slide out I could find in stock anywhere and it works.  The chrome looks nice

product_metadata.title: Household Essentials Narrow Sliding Cabinet Organizer, Two Tier Organizer, Matte Black, Great for Slim Cabinets in Kitchen, Bathroom and More
features: This two-tier sliding cabinet organizer helps keep even the narrowest cabinets organized and tidy.
Made of high-quality, thick wire on easy-gliding tracks that fully extend out of the cabinet space.
Use both tiers to hold items of different heights, or just the bottom tier to store taller items like cutting boards or baking sheets.
Easy installation into cabinets for stability.
description: If you’re sick of jumbled, disorganized cabinets, or trying to find use for a narrow cabinet that seems unusable, this sliding cabinet organizer might be just what you need. This two-tier sliding organizer installs into your cabinet to add organization and accessibility. The organizer is 21 inches long and 7 inches wide, making it perfect for narrow cabinet spaces. It makes a great addition to any cabinet size, whether you use it alone in a smaller cabinet, by itself in a larger cabinet, or even next to a full-width cabinet organizer in a wide cabinet. The organizer’s two tiers are made of commercial grade, heavy-duty wire that’s thicker and heavier-grade than other organizers on the market for quality that lasts. The two baskets slide out together on easy, full-extension ball-bearing glides. Use the two tiers to organize an assortment of kitchen supplies, utensils or pantry items, or use just the bottom basket to hold taller items like cutting boards and cooking trays or sheets. The organizer extends a full 21 inches out of the cabinet, allowing you to reach items in the furthest corners. This organizer comes partially assembled with pre-assembled glides. To complete assembly, add the second tier to the bottom tier and glides, or leave the top tier off. The organizer comes with all hardware needed for installation. To instal the organizer in your desired cabinet, simply mark the location of the holes and drill pilot holes. Then, line the organizer up with the holes and secure with the included screws. If additional height is needed (say, to clear the lower lip of a cabinet), use washers or wooden blocks between the bottom of the cabinet and bottom of the organizer. As is, the organizer will clear heights of 0.5 inches.
